title: mut.channel_refik_anadol
mutation_directive: Channel Refik Anadol's data-flow aesthetic. Massively increase particle count (target 200k+ via GPGPU FBO if not already present). Replace any noise-driven motion with a smooth, slow flow field that feels LIKE pouring data — particles should look like a ML-trained machine dreaming. Palette: pearlescent cyan-violet duotone with white-hot core highlights. Add subtle bloom-feeling additive glow. No hard edges anywhere. The result should feel architectural in scale even without architecture in the scene.
